annotations.title: Find MCP servers, skills and plugins

description: Finds MCP servers, connectors, Agent Skills and Claude Code plugins for a product or task among ~94k AI agent tools. Returns ranked matches with type, category, GitHub stars, badges (first_party = made by the product's own maker, verified_publisher, live, free_to_try), install line and KitScout page. Works best with short keywords: product + action, e.g. 'postgres', 'slack post message', 'pdf extract tables'. Also finds ready-made tools for single steps of a program or automation being planned (e.g. 'sap gui scripting', 'youtube upload', 'pdf invoice extract').

check_top.description: Also run check_tools on the first N results and attach verdict (ok / caution / avoid) with reasons to each. Saves a second call when you will recommend one of the top results. Default 0.

only_browser_callable.description: Only remote MCP servers a web page can call directly (they allow cross-origin requests, CORS): for agents that run in a browser, e.g. open agentic websites

only_free_to_try.description: Only remote MCP servers that worked without an API key

only_live.description: Only remote MCP servers that answered our latest daily check (including ones that answer with a sign-in/OAuth request)

only_verified.description: Only verified publishers (domain-verified registry namespace, Anthropic marketplace). Does not mean made by the product's vendor; see the first_party badge

query.description: Keywords (product names and actions work best)

name: search_tools
